verdict.rationale: Pylon documents its own default analytics dashboards with 'common support metrics' that can be filtered by many attributes, so the core dashboard capability exists. The evidence never names the specific metrics in the story. missing for 10: explicit evidence of resolution-rate, CSAT, AI-to-human handoff-rate and cost-per-resolution metrics, exec-ready reporting/export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, dashboards show resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, and cost per resolution — the numbers I report to my exec team

citations.quote: Pylon comes with a number of default analytics dashboards with common support metrics. All dashboards are filterable by a wide selection of default attributes
